name: SCHÖLLY FIBEROPTIC
description: SCHÖLLY FIBEROPTIC GMBH is a medical optics manufacturer founded in 1973 in Denzlingen, Germany, specializing in 3D endoscopes, camera systems, and micro-optics for minimally invasive surgery. For over two decades, the company was the primary OEM developer and manufacturer of 3D stereoscopic endoscopes for [Intuitive](/company/intuitive)'s da Vinci surgical systems. In July 2019, Intuitive acquired Schölly's robotic endoscope business and manufacturing facilities to bring its surgical vision production in-house.
